purpose: Teach: 会計士/生み出さ/染色/カスタム/補修/公約/不透明/枚数

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、会計士の協力、欠かせませんでした。
lines.en: The accountant's cooperation was essential to this case.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Slight pause before the statement, as if reviewing notes. Steady eye contact. No inflection—just factual weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新たな防犯策、警察の現場で、生み出されています。
lines.en: Yes. We're developing new crime prevention measures from insights gathered at the scene.
lines.style: Respectful, engaged tone. Lean forward slightly on 'developing'—showing investment. Measured pace, professional but not stiff. Nod implied.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、染色業界、出身者でした。
lines.en: The suspect had a background in the textile dye industry.
lines.style: Brief, clinical. State the fact without elaboration. Eyes level. No surprise in the voice—this is information being delivered, not discovered.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察への寄付、カスタムプログラムで、対応します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll address the police donation through a customized program that fits our community commitments.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight emphasis on 'customized' to show thoughtfulness. Warm undertone beneath the formality—showing this isn't just procedure to him.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察車両、補修、計画的に、進めております。
lines.en: Police vehicle repairs are moving forward according to schedule.
lines.style: Steady, assured. Even cadence. The tone of someone managing logistics competently. No hesitation—this is in hand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域への公約、企業として、果たしてまいります。
lines.en: Yes. As a company, we're committed to fulfilling our promises to this community.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. 'Committed' lands with slight emphasis. No grandiosity—just the tone of someone stating what they intend to do. Sincere.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠の先行き、不透明な状況、続いております。
lines.en: The trajectory of the evidence remains unclear at this point.
lines.style: Careful phrasing. Slight pause before 'remains'—choosing words precisely. Lower register, thoughtful. The tone of someone not rushing conclusions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提供する資料の枚数、必要分、ご用意します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll prepare all the documentation materials you'll need.
lines.style: Affirming, practical. Brisk efficiency without coldness. 'All' and 'need' land with quiet assurance. Ready to move forward.
